package.title: Messenger UX pack 2: icon rollback, list loader, ws-death tint, disclaimer, forms gating, sent checkmark (10 operator items)

specification.intent: Ten operator-reported messenger UX items of 2026-11-07 after PR #56: (1) restore the header's second-icon VISUAL from branch main (settings-icon.svg) while keeping the mark-all-read feature and its gating; (2) an inline three-dot loader in chat__container-users-list while the initial chats fetch runs and the list is empty; (3) a colored underlay under the change-profile avatar pencil so translucent SVG avatars stop bleeding through; (4) profile Submit changes / Change password disabled and unclickable until the form is dirty AND valid, live per keystroke; (5) the main profile row loses hover reactivity and the chat__container-profile-arrow chevron; (6) per-chat WS-death state surfaced as a red row tint (composed with ai/archived styles) plus an error-style service bubble «⚠ Чат недоступен» on entering/while-open, both reverted on socket recovery, never for intentional closes; (7) chat__disclaimer styled in the empty-hint family with a no-chats variant carrying the start-chat icon image and a «создать» button duplicating createAndSelect; (8) auto-title-hint text switched to the DEFINED light token --second-text-color (the referenced --secondary-text-color does not exist repo-wide) with the chip absolutely positioned above the title input; (9) chat-list-user__ai-badge restructured out of the truncating title into a non-clipping flex sibling; (10) optimistic own-message entry with an in-flight marker, replaced by the server echo, and a single sent checkmark on own messages carrying a server id. Operator pre-authorized execution and delegated blocker resolution to the controller — decisions journaled in decisions.md.

Пометить всё прочитанными'). headerIcons.test.ts pins the restored src and the unchanged gating. public/images/mark-all-read-icon.svg stays untouched (rollback hint D-1).

Search mode never shows the loader. Tests: flag true renders the li, flag false or non-empty list does not.

requirements.title: Pencil underlay on the change-profile avatar; quiet main profile row
requirements.description: chat.scss: (a) _type_change-profile gains a colored circle underlay (overlay-token family) between the fading img and the pencil so translucent SVG avatars do not bleed through; (b) the MAIN profile row loses hover affordance — the pencil background and img hover-opacity rules become scoped to the change-profile modifier; (c) profile.hbs drops the chat__container-profile-arrow img and chat.scss removes its block (:282-288). The change-profile variant keeps all affordances (decision D-6). Tests: DOM pin — no chat__container-profile-arrow element; underlay element present in the change-profile markup (class/structure pin); stylelint green.
requirements.source: operator items 3+5; research: no pseudo-element exists today, hover = img opacity over ava pencil background

requirements.title: Profile submit buttons disabled until dirty AND valid, live
requirements.description: ProfilePage constructor creates both submit buttons with disabled: true. A delegated page-level input listener (decision D-7 — imperative attribute toggle, NO re-render per keystroke) recomputes: account form dirty = serialized display_name/phone differ from the seeded user values; valid = every input's validator passes. Password form dirty = any of the three fields non-empty; valid = old non-empty + new passes passwordValidator + repeat equals new. The listener sets button.disabled via this.element querySelector. RESET SEMANTICS (review F-4, documented): the page re-renders on every store emit, registerComponent rebuilds the form and _setProfile reseeds values, and the buttons return from their descriptor (disabled:true) in the same render — self-consistent; a background emit wipes an in-progress edit exactly like the input drafts behave today. Tests: both forms' enable/disable transitions incl. revert-to-seed, invalid-phone, mismatch-repeat, AND the F-4 pin (a store emit mid-edit reseeds inputs and returns the button to disabled — an enabled button never survives over reseeded inputs).
requirements.source: operator item 4; research: no dirty state, blur-only validation, register.ts remap precedent rejected (focus loss) — D-7

requirements.title: Per-chat ws-death red tint + «⚠ Чат недоступен» bubble with recovery revert
requirements.description: Controller publishes the existing wsDeadChats set (controller.ts:179-183) to a chats-slice store key (array of ids, cast-idiom like chatSearch — NOT a ChatInfo field: fetchChats replaces the chats array): handleWsDied adds+publishes, handleWsReconnected/forgetWsDeath remove+publish. withChats maps each chat with isDead; chatListUser.hbs adds chat-list-user_dead composed after _ai/_archived (dead visually wins — red tint respecting the row style: AI rows keep the badge/star and take the red treatment); chat-list-user.scss defines _dead (red border/background family tokens). Notice: synthetic Message {chat_id, time now, type 'message', user_id: -1, content '⚠ Чат недоступен', isError: true, isChatUnavailable: true} — new client-only flag isChatUnavailable on Message (sibling of isPending/isError). Pushed IDEMPOTENTLY (review F-6) in selectChat when the target chat is dead (only if no isChatUnavailable entry exists yet — repeated opens never stack), and in handleWsDied when the dead chat is currently selected; handleWsReconnected/forgetWsDeath filter isChatUnavailable entries out (dropPending pattern). Intentional closes never tint/notify (existing adapter marks — unchanged). Tests extend the ws-death describe (chats.test.ts:1459): publish/retract the dead key, row modifier end-to-end (chat.test.ts page-level precedent :505), notice on open + while open, double-open idempotency pin, removal on recovery, negative pins for intentional closes.
requirements.source: operator item 6 + ws research (dead set exists, UI surfacing missing; busy-overlay untouched — strictly additive)

requirements.title: Disclaimer restyle + no-chats variant with a create action
requirements.description: messenger.hbs else-branch: withChats supplies hasNoChats = !chatsLoading && chats.length === 0. Default variant keeps «Chatty: Выберите чат чтобы отправить сообщение»; the no-chats variant renders «Chatty: создайте чат с помощью кнопки» + inline img.chat__header-icon /images/start-chat-icon.svg + «либо нажмите» + button[data-testid=disclaimer-create] «создать» (empty-hint-button visual family, messenger.scss:29-71). Click delegation in messenger.ts (empty-chat-add precedent :557-564) calls the onCreateChat prop threaded chat.hbs → chat.ts → () => { void ChatsController.createAndSelect() } (header onClick precedent :443-450). Both variants styled in the empty-hint text family (centered, main text color for the primary line). Tests: variant switch by hasNoChats; disclaimer-create click fires onCreateChat (stub).
requirements.source: operator item 7; research: bare h2 today, two in-repo precedents for the action

requirements.title: auto-title-hint: defined light token + absolute raised chip
requirements.description: messenger.scss:73-84 — color switches from the UNDEFINED --secondary-text-color (bug-fund: the token does not exist repo-wide) to --second-text-color (decision D-5); the chip becomes position: absolute, raised slightly above the title input (slight overlap acceptable; offsets chosen to clear the header layout). A test/regex pin asserts no '--secondary-text-color' remains in src/scss and the chip rule carries --second-text-color.

requirements.title: AI badge always visible next to long titles
requirements.description: chatListUser.hbs: the ai-badge span moves OUT of the truncating h4 __title; the content header becomes a flex row — a title span carrying min-width:0 + the existing ellipsis rules and the badge span flex:0 0 auto (never clipped). chat-list-user.scss updated accordingly (single-line truncation preserved). Tests: existing ai-badge/archived describes stay green; NEW pin — with a very long title the badge is a flex sibling of the title span (not inside it) and the title span keeps text-overflow: ellipsis.
requirements.source: operator item 9; research: badge is inline content inside the overflow:hidden h4

requirements.title: Optimistic own message + sent checkmark
requirements.description: Message DTO gains client-only ownTempId?: string (sibling of isPending; types.ts). controller.sendMessage appends, BEFORE the WS send, {chat_id, time now, type 'message', user_id: me, content, replyTo (when replying — review F-8), ownTempId} to messages.${chatId} (one store emit; module-counter ids tmp-N). The ws Message handler (own.ts:220-245) replace condition (review F-3): incoming user_id === viewer id (the adapter already reads store.getState().user?.id at own.ts:82/:162) AND an ownTempId entry exists for that chat — the OLDEST such temp is replaced with the incoming server message in the same store emit; content equality is NEVER the primary matcher (another member's identical text must not consume a pending own temp) and may only tie-break among multiple own temps; the server-id dedup check stays. messageCacheKey (messenger.ts:46-52) maps ownTempId → `owntmp:${id}` (instance reuse in flight). message.hbs: own bubbles render a status marker — an in-flight dot for temp entries and a single «✓» (sent — accepted by the server, not read) for own messages with a numeric id; messenger.scss styles the marker (zero comments). AI pending tail and waitForOwnEcho untouched (temp carries no numeric id; knownIds snapshot unchanged). Tests: controller append/replace-without-duplicate; adapter replace gated by viewer id (incl. the foreign-same-text negative); component ✓ / in-flight markers; mapper owntmp key.
requirements.source: operator item 10 + research (nothing renders pre-echo today, no sent marker exists)

specification.goal: The operator's ten rough edges are closed: the header icon matches what they remember, the chat list never sits empty-silent while loading, the avatar pencil sits on a clean underlay, profile forms cannot submit garbage, the profile row stops pretending to be clickable, dead sockets are visible at a glance (red rows + an honest «Чат недоступен» bubble that clears on recovery), the empty state offers chat creation, the auto-title chip reads correctly and sits above the input, the AI badge survives long titles, and every own message shows an honest in-flight→✓ lifecycle.
constraints: No backend changes; no WS protocol changes; no new dependencies.

Store additions are exactly: AppState.chatsLoading?: boolean, the chats-slice dead-ids key (cast-idiom, NOT a ChatInfo field), Message.ownTempId?: string and Message.isChatUnavailable?: boolean (client-only siblings of isPending/isError).
busyOverlay refcount semantics untouched; per-chat tint strictly additive.
Change-profile avatar keeps its affordances; only the main profile row is de-hovered.
The sent checkmark means accepted-by-server; no read receipts.
No comments in new/edited scss; imports with .ts extension; eslint:fix/stylelint:fix before commit; pre-commit verify is strict.
Existing suites stay green; no test deleted; mocha counts grow from 733.
Conventional commits without co-author trailers; plan package committed; work/ never committed.
nonGoals: per-message retry UI for failed sends in non-AI chats
restoring the branch-main settings BEHAVIOR (only the visual asset returns)

securityGates.statement: WSTransport, HTTPTransport, busyOverlay and the auth feature are forbidden writes; the per-chat tint rides the existing gateway events only.

The optimistic entry renders through the same escape-html message pipeline as every bubble (titleHtml/content escaping untouched); the echo replace matches by user/chat/oldest-temp and never trusts client content as markup.
